Courses
The AI uses Full Course Name, Course Code, and Keyword(s) to recognize a course even when a result sheet only shows a code or a slightly different name (e.g. "EEE 2203" → matched to your course automatically). Short Name is what shows up everywhere else in the app — dashboard, sheet, charts. Tip: add the teacher's name to Keyword(s) too — result sheets often label a test by teacher rather than course.

Could not load the result
A few things that usually fix this:
• If the file has more than one class test, check "Multiple Exam" and set each course/CT before uploading.
• Make sure the file is a clear photo/scan, or a spreadsheet with a proper header row.
• Marks must be plain numbers between 0 and 20 — remove extra symbols like "18/20" or "A+".
• Very large or blurry images sometimes fail — try cropping to just the result table.
• If it keeps failing, try again — the AI reading can be inconsistent on messy sheets.

Could not find classmate data
A few things that usually fix this:
• Make sure the file actually lists roll numbers and names together — a class list, admit card list, or spreadsheet with a Roll/Name column.
• Fill in your class's Starting Roll and Ending Roll above — it helps the AI recognize which numbers are rolls.
• For photos or scans, make sure the text is sharp and not cut off at the edges.
• Spreadsheets should have a clear header row (e.g. "Roll", "Name").
• If it keeps failing, try again — the AI reading can be inconsistent on messy files.
